title: Contents Packout & Storage Wardrobe Hanging Charge at Pack-Back
content:
Contents Packout & Storage wardrobe boxes are unpacked onto hanging rods at the pack-back. On the pack-back box line of a return: **when the wardrobe box quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the wardrobe volume threshold, as many wardrobe boxes as that threshold carry the standard hanging charge and each wardrobe box beyond it carries the volume hanging charge; when they total at least one but fewer than the wardrobe volume threshold, each wardrobe box carries the standard hanging charge; a job with no wardrobe box carries no hanging charge.**

## Hanging charge sheet

| Wardrobe boxes on the job's packout lines | Hanging charge |
|---|---|
| 20 or more (at least the wardrobe volume threshold) | 20 boxes at 5.50 (standard), plus each box beyond 20 at 4.25 (volume) |
| 1 to 19 | each box at 5.50 |
| none | none |

The boxes counted are the quantities on the wardrobe box packing lines booked on the job.

## Boundary cases

| Wardrobe boxes | Hanging charge |
|---|---|
| 19 | 19 times 5.50, or 104.50 |
| 20 | 20 times 5.50, or 110.00 |
| 26 | 110.00 plus 6 times 4.25 (25.50), or 135.50 |
